<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🎙️ Pipecat: Real-Time Voice & Multimodal AI Agents</h1><a id="user-content-️-pipecat-real-time-voice--multimodal-ai-agents" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🎙️ Pipecat: Real-Time Voice & Multimodal AI Agents" href="#️-pipecat-real-time-voice--multimodal-ai-agents"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Pipecat</strong> is an open-source Python framework for building real-time voice and multimodal conversational agents. Build a single voice agent or a full multi-agent system where specialists hand off, fan out in parallel, and coordinate over a shared bus, locally or distributed across processes and machines. Orchestrate audio and video, AI services, transports, and conversation pipelines effortlessly, so you can focus on what makes your agents unique.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Want to dive right in? Run <code>pipecat init quickstart</code> or follow the <a href="https://docs.pipecat.ai/getting-started/quickstart" rel="nofollow">quickstart guide</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🚀 What you can build</h2><a id="user-content--what-you-can-build" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🚀 What you can build" href="#-what-you-can-build"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Voice Assistants</strong> – natural, streaming conversations with AI</li>
<li><strong>Multi-Agent Systems</strong> – specialists that hand off, fan out in parallel, or run as sidecars over a shared bus</li>
<li><strong>AI Companions</strong> – coaches, meeting assistants, characters</li>
<li><strong>Multimodal Interfaces</strong> – voice, video, images, and more</li>
<li><strong>Interactive Storytelling</strong> – creative tools with generative media</li>
<li><strong>Business Agents</strong> – customer intake, support bots, guided flows</li>
<li><strong>Complex Dialog Systems</strong> – design logic with structured conversations</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🧠 Why Pipecat?</h2><a id="user-content--why-pipecat" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🧠 Why Pipecat?" href="#-why-pipecat"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Voice-first</strong>: Integrates speech recognition, text-to-speech, and conversation handling</li>
<li><strong>Pluggable</strong>: Supports many AI services and tools</li>
<li><strong>Composable Pipelines</strong>: Build complex behavior from modular components</li>
<li><strong>Multi-Agent Ready</strong>: Each pipeline is an agent. Compose them with handoff, parallel fan-out, sidecar workers, or distributed deployments</li>
<li><strong>Real-Time</strong>: Ultra-low latency interaction with different transports (e.g. WebSockets or WebRTC)</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://docs.pipecat.ai/api-reference/cli/overview" rel="nofollow">Pipecat CLI</a> ships with <code>pipecat-ai</code> — install it with <code>uv tool install "pipecat-ai[cli]"</code>. Run <code>pipecat init</code> to start a project: it sets you up so an AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Codex) builds it for you, and can scaffold a runnable bot in under a minute. Then use the CLI to monitor and deploy your agent to production.</p>

<p dir="auto">Run Pipecat on your local machine, then move your agent processes to the cloud when you're ready. Either way, you'll need <a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/" rel="nofollow">uv</a> — install it first:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh"><pre>curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh <span class="pl-k">|</span> sh</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Start a new project with the CLI</h3><a id="user-content-start-a-new-project-with-the-cli" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Start a new project with the CLI" href="#start-a-new-project-with-the-cli"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The quickest path: install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold a new phone or web/mobile bot interactively.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="uv tool install "pipecat-ai[cli]"
pipecat init"><pre>uv tool install <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>pipecat-ai[cli]<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
pipecat init</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Follow the <a href="https://docs.pipecat.ai/getting-started/quickstart" rel="nofollow">quickstart guide</a> to get your very first bot running, or dive a little deeper into <a href="https://docs.pipecat.ai/pipecat/get-started/build-your-next-bot" rel="nofollow">bootstrapping a project</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Manual installation</h3><a id="user-content-manual-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Manual installation" href="#manual-installation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Prefer to wire things up yourself?</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto">Install the module</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# For new projects
uv init my-pipecat-app
cd my-pipecat-app
uv add pipecat-ai

# Or for existing projects
uv add pipecat-ai"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> For new projects</span>
uv init my-pipecat-app
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> my-pipecat-app
uv add pipecat-ai

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Or for existing projects</span>
uv add pipecat-ai</pre></div>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Set up your environment</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cp env.example .env"><pre>cp env.example .env</pre></div>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">To keep things lightweight, only the core framework is included by default. If you need support for third-party AI services, you can add the necessary dependencies with:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="uv add "pipecat-ai[option,...]""><pre>uv add <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>pipecat-ai[option,...]<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span></pre></div>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Using pip?</strong> You can still use <code>pip install pipecat-ai</code> and <code>pip install "pipecat-ai[option,...]"</code> to get set up.</p>
</blockquote>

<p dir="auto">We welcome contributions from the community! Whether you're fixing bugs, improving documentation, or adding new features, here's how you can help:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Found a bug?</strong> Open an <a href="https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/issues">issue</a></li>
<li><strong>Have a feature idea?</strong> Start a <a href="https://discord.gg/pipecat" rel="nofollow">discussion</a></li>
<li><strong>Want to contribute code?</strong> Check our <a href="/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md">CONTRIBUTING.md</a> guide</li>
<li><strong>Documentation improvements?</strong> <a href="https://github.com/pipecat-ai/docs">Docs</a> PRs are always welcome</li>
</ul>
